name: teacher-tests
description: Playwright E2E tests for the Teacher Portal (Phases 1 & 2: Login/Onboarding and the Command Center dashboard), run against the local Firebase emulators (Firestore 8080, Auth 9099, Functions 5001, Database 9000) with the app served locally via `npx serve -p 3000` from the repo root. See ../teacher-portal-test-plan.md for the full manual QA plan this suite is automating, phase by phase.
